studio.placeholder: Type or paste the text you want to hear. Long scripts are split on sentence breaks and stitched into one file.
studio.sample: Good morning. Here is the Monday summary. Two apps shipped over the weekend: Map App version thirty, which adds clustered markers, and the object creator node, which now validates column names before saving. One issue is still open: the ETL transformation step fails when a source column is renamed mid-run. The fix is in review and should land by Wednesday.
